title: Conditions & Decisions: Branching & Truthiness
description: Master control flow with if, else if, and else blocks, logical operators (&&, ||, !), truthy/falsy evaluation, and clean decision logic.

objectives.statement: Construct if, else if, and else control flow branches combined with logical operators to make decisions based on state.
Evaluate truthy and falsy values accurately in conditional contexts.

content.title: Making Decisions in Code
content.hook: Programs without conditions can only execute the same rigid sequence from top to bottom. With branching, your code can adapt dynamically to user inputs and changing data.
content.context: Conditional statements (if, else if, else) evaluate expressions to boolean truth. Combined with logical AND (&&), OR (||), and NOT (!), you can build sophisticated business rules.
goals: Author clean if / else if / else branching structures.
Use logical operators (&&, ||, !) with short-circuit evaluation.
Know the 6 falsy values in JavaScript and treat empty collections as truthy.

content.title: Truthy vs Falsy in JavaScript
content.description: Exactly 6 primitive values are falsy in JavaScript: false, 0, '' (empty string), null, undefined, and NaN. All other values, including empty arrays [] and objects {}, evaluate to truthy.

content.prompt: What grade will be printed to the console?
content.explanation: Since score is 85, score >= 90 is false. score >= 80 is true, setting grade to 'B'. Subsequent branches are skipped.

feedback.correct: Correct! 85 falls into the second branch (score >= 80).
feedback.incorrect: Evaluate each branch in order: 85 is not >= 90, but is >= 80.

content.title: Author User Access Verification Logic
content.prompt: Given `userRole = 'member'` and `isEmailVerified = true`, create `let accessStatus = 'denied'`. Write an if/else if structure: If `userRole === 'admin'`, set `accessStatus = 'full'`. Else if `userRole === 'member' && isEmailVerified`, set `accessStatus = 'standard'`. Else, keep `accessStatus = 'denied'`.

testCases.description: accessStatus must equal 'standard' for verified member

feedback.correct: Nice job! You correctly used logical AND (&&) with branch conditions.
feedback.incorrect: Check that you test userRole === 'admin' first, then userRole === 'member' && isEmailVerified.

content.question: Which of the following values evaluates to FALSY in JavaScript conditional contexts?
content.explanation: 0 is one of the 6 falsy primitives in JavaScript. Objects and arrays (even when empty) are truthy.

feedback.correct: Correct! 0 is falsy, while empty arrays and objects are truthy objects.
feedback.incorrect: Remember: empty arrays [] and empty objects {} are truthy!

content.title: Conditions & Decisions Mastered
takeaways: Use if, else if, and else blocks to create clear decision trees.
Combine conditions using logical operators: && (AND), || (OR), and ! (NOT).
Remember the 6 falsy values: false, 0, '', null, undefined, NaN.
nextSteps: Learn how to repeat computations with loops and iteration.
